# Ho-Smart v0.2.3 — Recover missed cloud alarms and correct motion pulses

**Focus:** Fix Home Assistant driveway-alarm misses caused by short cloud-history lookback windows and delayed notification timestamps.

## Why this update was developed

On October 22, 2026, a physical driveway detection sounded the HS006W receiver but did not appear in Home Assistant. Diagnosis found intermittent cloud communication failures and two integration problems: after an outage, a short three-minute history window could skip older alerts; delayed cloud notices could also fail to activate the motion entity because the ten-second pulse was calculated from the original alarm time.

## What changed

- Resume cloud-history queries from the last successful check instead of losing alarms after outages longer than three minutes.
- Start the driveway motion entity's ten-second active pulse when a fresh alert is **received**, not when the remote event originally happened.
- Use an independent expiration timer so the motion sensor returns OFF even without another cloud update.
- Avoid firing new live-motion automations for recovered cloud notices older than two minutes.
- Prevent recovered older notices from replacing newer last-activity data, and restrict the driveway motion pulse to receiver channel one.
- Add cloud reporting connectivity diagnostics and the last received alarm timestamp.

## Limitations and testing

Recovery only works for alerts **recorded by Ho-Smart's cloud**. The update cannot recreate a physical alarm missing from the manufacturer's history. Real-world testing against actual driveway passes is required to confirm end-to-end behavior.

## Installation

Update through HACS and restart Home Assistant. No account or receiver reconfiguration is required.

**Full changelog:** [Compare v0.2.2...v0.2.3](https://github.com/gigabytegrove/hosmart-home-assistant/compare/v0.2.2...v0.2.3)
